title: Terminal work is only one term of the service ledger
statement: Reported modeled terminal work871.04J excludes source racks,2h warmups, application input and facility conditioning. The introduced64-daily-service cap ledger is174.615kWh, versus about2078kWh continuously warm. First laboratory allowance$87900 and modeled$2.91 shared/$40.29 dedicated per service depend on paid sharing, calendar life and assumptions. Conventional internally addressed relay banks may be cheaper; no economic advantage or measured full manufacture energy is established.
